title: Why AI Architecture Progress Is Filtered by Hardware | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: Why AI Architecture Progress Is Filtered by Hardware
description:
In production AI, the architectures that survive are the ones that fit kernels, memory hierarchies, and serving stacks, not just the ones with the prettiest papers.

This cinematic brief compresses the hardware-compatibility thesis behind modern model architecture: FlashAttention, GQA, MLA, and MoE spread because they map cleanly onto real infrastructure.

It should pull viewers toward the deeper long-form argument that architecture success is an economic and systems story, not only a research story.
